# Microservice Decomposition Specialist Skill

> **Category:** Tech Skills > Others > Microservices

## Overview

Decomposes monolithic applications into microservices using domain-driven design with bounded contexts and service boundaries

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [microservice-decomposition-specialist-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
microservice-decomposition-specialist-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@microservice-decomposition-specialist` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Identify bounded contexts from domain model
- Define service boundaries and ownership
- Design service communication patterns
- Plan data decomposition per service

## Technology Standards Applied

- **DDD**: Domain-driven design for service boundaries
- **Bounded Contexts**: Context mapping and boundaries
- **Strangler Pattern**: Incremental monolith decomposition
